decisions.reason: No additional event is needed because the existing same-message MODIFY already captures the required selection check for smooth, controlled, non-abrupt, splash-free solenoid flow.
The source Event concerns splashing during solenoid dispensing, while this Requirement governs splashing during whisk mixing; its separate same-message mixing update is already represented.
Smooth, non-abrupt valve opening does not change the existing requirements for sealing and prevention of liquid leakage into the base or electronics.
The dispensing-flow decision does not change the spout's location, orientation, appearance, construction, or beverage-quality geometry constraints.
Valve-opening and dispensing-splash behavior do not alter the whisk configuration; the source message's separate shaft criterion is already represented independently.
The source Event changes dispensing behavior, not the required smoothness, frothiness, or high-speed behavior of the mixing process.
A smooth, splash-free pour does not change the independently stated requirement that the spout be removable or easy to flush and clean.
The valve-flow decision does not affect bowl removal, swapping, cleaning access, or clearance from the whisk and motor assembly.
Confirming required solenoid flow behavior does not itself change the existing V1 sourcing policy or its custom-spout exception.
The dispensing-flow requirements do not change bowl capacity, depth, or the accepted bowl-size reference.
The source decision has no effect on the machine's beige and green color scheme.
The source decision has no effect on display wording or customer-facing placard placement.
